data.summary: The reviews for Deluxe Roofing and Construction appear overwhelmingly authentic. They are detailed, specific, and describe positive experiences with named employees. The perfect 5.0 Google rating with 18 reviews and an A+ BBB rating with no complaints is plausible for a high-quality contractor. The only minor concern is the repetitive mention of the same few employees, which could indicate a strong review-request culture but does not necessarily indicate fakery.
fake_signals: Multiple reviews mention the same employee names (Bobby Binion, Dewey Fischer, Michael) in a promotional tone
Some reviews are cut off mid-sentence, which is unusual for genuine posts
authentic_signals: Reviews contain specific project details (insurance claims, class 4 roof, skylights, hail damage)
Mentions of specific timelines and processes (done in a day, year-long struggle with Allstate)
Varied writing styles and perspectives from different customers
Positive reviews are detailed and emotionally authentic, not generic
data.discrepancy_explanation: All available ratings are consistently high. BBB has an A+ rating with no complaints, and Google has a perfect 5.0. No contradictory low ratings were found on other platforms.

reviews.text: Bobby Binion was the representative who assisted me with my claim.   Him and his team did a great job of corresponding with insurance claim adjuster and getting my roof replaced.  All while keeping me in the loop and once everything was approved, doing it in a day!  I highly recommend this company for their professionalism and overall quality of work.   Thank you Bobby for doing such a great job and making the claim process easy!  We love our class 4 roof!
reviews.author: Joseph Cancino

reviews.text:
Bobby Binion with Deluxe Roofing is truly one of a kind.

I’ve worked with Bobby several times over the years, and he has repeatedly gone above and beyond for me and my clients. He single-handedly saved one of my transactions, and I will never forget how he stepped in with professionalism, calm, and expertise when we needed him most.

Bobby takes the time to really listen, explain everything clearly, and answer every question with patience and honesty. His integrity is unmatched, and I know I can trust him completely, both as a Realtor and as someone who cares deeply about his clients’ best interests.

If you need a roofer you can rely on, someone who will show up, do quality work, and treat you with respect, Bobby Binion is the person you want on your side. I recommend him wholeheartedly.

reviews.text:
Dewy Fischer is hands down the best contractor I’ve dealt with.  VERY knowledgeable and well versed at application of said knowledge.  He didn’t try to jerk me around on anything, he kept me in the loop for the whole process and clearly communicated and addressed everything on time every time.

I’m back and forth outta state so it was very reassuring having him as my point of contact.  I felt very in control knowing Delux was in control.

Israel

reviews.text: Finding a roofing company with true integrity, strong work ethic, and outstanding customer service is rare—Deluxe Roofing and Construction delivers on all counts. After severe hail damage and a year-long struggle with Allstate, owner Chad and project manager Michael guided us through every step with professionalism and patience. Their crews were on time, highly skilled, and left our property spotless. The final result was excellent and we couldn't be happier with our new roof and gutters. We are deeply grateful and recommend Deluxe Roofing without hesitation.
reviews.author: Evelyn P.

reviews.text: We are very happy with the roofing and paint jobs that Deluxe Roofing & Construction did for our home. Everything was done timely and well!  I want to also particularly recognize Dewey Fisher who went above and beyond for us from the time we met him throughout the process. We can’t say enough good things about this whole experience!

reviews.text:

Declan is amazing. Walked me through all the steps, managed the roof replacement including the skylights in the most professional way I have ever experienced with any construction company or any company for that matter.

I would highly recommend them to anyone for a fair price, good workmanship and caring, respectful and professional attitude.

reviews.text: Dewey is simply the best. If you value integrity, honesty and great work he's your guy! He was able to guide me and offer me the best options for my roof repair. I highly recommend him!

reviews.text: Michael was so helpful, he explained everything to me and made sure to answer any questions I had. The crew got all the work done in 1 day & cleaned up everything very thoroughly. I highly recommend working with Deluxe Roofing!

reviews.text:
Deluxe Roofing Review

I first met Michael Boyle of Deluxe Roofing about two years ago when he was doing roofing jobs in my area at Lake Texoma. I found him to be very personable and his customers seemed to like him so I decided to do a bunch of research on Deluxe Roofing.

Almost all of their reviews are outstanding and the before and after pictures show starter homes to many million dollar homes. I also did a lot of research about roofers on YouTube and Michael was able to answer all my questions to my satisfaction.

He inspected my house and found a lot of hail damage. He also determined that the attic exhaust ventilation needed to be increased by 50% and that I needed some bathroom fans to be exhausted to the outside rather than into the attic. He also suggested that I should install leaf guards on the gutters since my house is surrounded by trees.

Michael gave me a good price to upgrade from class 2 shingles to class 4 shingles. My added cost was almost equal to my first year savings on my State Farm homeowners insurance because I had class 4 shingles.

When my State Farm adjuster came out to the house to survey the damage, Michael was there to make sure no damage was missed.

Michael was also at the house on the day of installation to oversee the total installation of the roof and gutters. He stayed until everything was done.

I was very impressed by the competency of the roofers and gutter crew as well as their efficiency. I think they did an outstanding quality job.

I should add that I didn’t make any payments to Deluxe Roofing until the job was complete. A lot of roofers want you to give them money in advance.

In closing, I highly recommend Deluxe Roofing and Michael Boyle for all your roofing needs.
reviews.author: James Koehlinger

reviews.text: Dewy Fischer was great to work with! He was professional, honest, and quick, with great communication throughout the whole process. The work was high-quality and hassle-free. Highly recommend and will definitely use again!
reviews.author: Julia Wang

reviews.text:
I rarely give reviews, but Michael and Deluxe roofing deserve the recognition of doing an excellent job.   After the spring hail storm, Michael was one of the first person's  to stop by and offer help.  At first I was a little hesitant, but after a quick look at the reviews on the internet I went with Deluxe roofing.   I'm glad I did.  Michael and Deluxe went to work quickly.  My house was the first with a new roof and first for all the other completed repairs (new garage; new gutters; refacing the fence; repainted the shed; replace window screens and three windows).   Michael even found a garage door replacement that was better than my existing door.  Looks better, works better.  Michael and the Deluxe team handled all the paper work with my insurance.  Made the whole process easy.

Thank you Michael and Deluxe roofing.  Good Job !
reviews.author: Dale Burnham

reviews.text: Deluxe handled the repairs to my house after a bad hail storm. Ty Shriver and the rest of the crew were always on top of every project and did it in a timely manner. They were very responsive and communication was clear throughout my time working with them. I would highly recommend them!
reviews.author: Shelby

reviews.text: Deluxe and Michael Boyle have gone above and beyond in repairing the damage to our house after the hail storm.  His patience’s while I felt with my wife’s death from cancer was remarkable. Because of Michael and Deluxe my house was one of the first houses on the block with a new roof.  All repairs were done quickly and excellent while he still felt with other houses in the area. I would work with Deluxe and Michael again.
reviews.author: Grant Hunt

reviews.text:
Michael was awesome, shortly after the spring hail event that severely damaged our home, Michael stopped by to assess the damage. Having already chased away several ‘fly-by-night’ roofers, I asked Michael one simple question- can you fix everything and will you be willing to fight the insurance company to make sure we are made whole… He said he would and guaranteed quality craftsmanship. Deluxe delivered exactly what I expected! A new class 4 roof. New gutters and many window replacements and new 3 bay garage doors! All of the crews were professional, quick and provided quality craftsmanship that is backed by a real guarantee.

Any time your home is damaged by a storm it is stressful and difficult. Selecting a contractor that can be trusted is tough, but with Deluxe and people like Michael that will advocate for you and deliver the service you should expect, the weight of home repair can easily be lifted off your shoulders. I’m glad I picked Deluxe and I’m glad they are an A+ BBB business with very high customer reviews. I would recommend Deluxe to all my family and friends and should I ever find myself in need of home repair again I know all I have to do is make one phone call to Deluxe and the job is as good as done!

Thanks Michael and Team Deluxe! 6 out of five stars!!
reviews.author: Gregg Alexander

reviews.text: Bobby and his team did a fantastic job on my roof. As mentioned in the review below Bobby is very trustworthy. I appreciated that his crew was able to complete the job while I was at work. Did a great job with the cleanup as well. The follow up walk through was very professional. Bobby did a great job of explaining everything and ensuring that the work was done right. Highly recommend Deluxe Roofing.
